english.question: Which ailment does Sam have to face due to his weight?

chinese.question: 萨姆因为体重不得不面对什么疾病？

english.speaker: Sam
english.text: Thanks, Evan. Appreciate the offer, but had a check-up with my doctor a few days ago and, yikes, the weight wasn't great. It was pretty eye-opening.

chinese.speaker: 萨姆
chinese.text: 谢谢，埃文。谢谢你的好意，不过几天前我去医生那里做了个体检，哎呀，体重状况不太好。还挺让人警醒的。

english.speaker: Sam
english.text: Hey Evan, sorry to hear about what happened. I can imagine how hard it must have been for you. Things haven't been easy for me either. Had a tough week and a doc's appointment, so it was kinda like a wake-up call to take better care of myself. On a bright side, I'm taking a cooking class to learn how to make healthier meals.

chinese.speaker: 萨姆
chinese.text: 嘿埃文，听到这事我很难过。我能想象这对你来说有多不容易。我这段时间也不轻松。这周过得很艰难，还去看了医生，这算是给我敲了个警钟，要更好地照顾自己。好的一面是，我正在上烹饪课，学习做更健康的饭菜。

english.speaker: Sam
english.text: Hey Evan, hope you're doing okay. I wanted to chat about something that's been bothering me lately... I went for a check-up Monday and my doc said my weight's a serious health risk - if I don't make changes soon, it can get worse. I know I made jokes about it, but it's really hitting me. Been having a hard time.

chinese.speaker: 萨姆
chinese.text: 嘿，埃文，希望你还好。我想聊聊最近一直困扰我的一件事……星期一我去做了个体检，医生说我的体重已经构成严重的健康风险——如果我不尽快做出改变，情况会恶化。我知道我之前还拿这事开玩笑，但现在真的感受到压力了。这段时间挺难熬的。

english.speaker: Sam
english.text: Hey Evan! I've been missing our chats. I had quite the health scare last weekend - ended up in the ER with a severe stomachache. Turns out, it was gastritis, which was pretty alarming. It was a wake-up call for me to start prioritizing my health, like adopting a more nutritious diet and getting regular exercise. On top of that, my phone's been giving me a hard time, adding to the stress.

chinese.speaker: 萨姆
chinese.text: 嘿，埃文！我一直很想念我们聊天。上周末我的健康出了点大状况——因为剧烈的胃痛去了急诊室。结果发现是胃炎，还挺吓人的。这对我来说是个警钟，得开始重视健康了，比如吃得更营养、规律锻炼。另外，我的手机也一直给我添麻烦，压力更大了。

english.speaker: Jolene

chinese.speaker: 乔琳

chinese.answer: 找不到允许宠物的地方。

english.text: Seeing them do well is super rewarding! They give me so much love and happiness. I get how frustrating it can be not to find pet-friendly spots. Nature is so calming and restorative with them around. See how happy they are when they're out.

chinese.text: 看到它们表现好真的特别有成就感！它们给我满满的爱和幸福。我懂找不到允许宠物的地方有多让人沮丧。有它们在身边，大自然特别让人平静、治愈。看看它们出去时有多开心。

chinese.question: 什么活动能帮助内特逃避现实、让头脑麻木？

english.speaker: Nate
english.text: I love fantasy and sci-fi movies, they're a great escape and get my imagination going. Playing video games is a great way to express my creativity and passion.

chinese.speaker: 内特
chinese.text: 我喜欢奇幻和科幻电影，它们是很好的 escape，能激发我的想象力。玩电子游戏是表达我的创造力和热情的好方式。

english.question: What is Gina's attitude towards participating in the dance festival?

english.text: Yeah, awesome! Glad to be part of it.

chinese.speaker: 乔恩
chinese.text: 是啊，太棒了！很高兴能参与其中。

english.question: What does Melanie's necklace symbolize?

chinese.question: 梅拉妮的项链象征着什么？

english.speaker: Caroline
english.text: Thanks, Melanie! This necklace is super special to me - a gift from my grandma in my home country, Sweden. She gave it to me when I was young, and it stands for love, faith and strength. It's like a reminder of my roots and all the love and support I get from my family.

chinese.speaker: 卡罗琳
chinese.text: 谢谢,梅拉妮!这条项链对我特别重要——是我奶奶送我的礼物,她在我祖国的家乡瑞典。我小时候她送给我,它代表着爱、信念和力量。它就像在提醒我我的根,以及我从家人那里得到的所有爱和支持。
